notes:
Account snapshot: mid-to-large contact center platform that resells/supports multi-tenant CX stacks.

Recent timeline:
- 2024-10-15: Intro + demo (Fireflies ff_20241015_Lk8m). AE Maya + SE Omar. Quick win: live agent-assist mock with canned KB.
- 2024-10-29: Deep dive w/ security + platform (ff_20241029_Aq2p). Requested SOC2 evidence + KMS pattern.
- 2024-11-01: Onsite infra/POC planning call; agreed scope for 3-week POC (POC start target 2024-11-20).
- Ongoing: Gmail thread gthread_42b9s contains legal questions; security deck shared in Drive.

Use-case & requirements (customer language / shorthand):
- Primary: agent-assist for live chat + voice transcripts (context windows up to 6k tokens), real-time suggestions for agents.
- Secondary: nightly ticket-summarization pipeline (batch), automated ticket triage + tool-calling to update ticketing system (create/update/status).
- RAG specifics: must return per-sentence citations and source links; freshness window for KB ingestion = 24h for product docs and 2h for outage pages; multi-source retrieval (KB + forum + incident logs) and deterministic provenance required for audit.
- Latency/throughput: target p95 end-to-end agent-assist < 450ms during steady state; P99 SLA target < 900ms. Expected steady throughput 120-200 reqs/s; spike scenarios up to 800 reqs/s (seasonal + incident surges).
- Cost sensitivity: willing to mix model tiers (distilled for low-cost routing; larger LLM for escalation) — want clear unit economics by route.
- Model preferences: open-models OK if Redwood can provide verified perf profiles; prefer model pinning and canary rollouts.
- Reliability: automated fallback to smaller model or cached answers during GPU saturation; prefer built-in circuit-breaker + region fallback.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), per-call audit logs, KMS for keys, retention controls, and EU data residency for EU customers.

POC scope (agreed):
- Week 1: ingest 3 canonical KB sources + forum dump; configure retriever + citation policy.
- Week 2: agent-assist integration with front-end demo; tool-calling hook to ticketing API (sandbox).
- Week 3: load runbook — simulate steady + spike traffic; validate fallback behaviors; cost estimate.

Quotes / paraphrases from stakeholders:
- "We need provenance on every answer — our CS reps can't be guessing where responses come from." — Head of Product.
- "If we can't get predictable latency during incidents, we won't roll out to our largest customers." — VP Ops.

Technical notes (from SE):
- Need support for multi-source retriever with de-dup scoring and per-snippet timestamps to enforce freshness.
- Prefer server-side prefix caching + KV cache of recent conversations to reduce token costs under spikes.
- Auditability: every tool-call and generated suggestion must be logged with request id, model version, and KB citations.

Decision criteria & stakeholders:
- Must meet SOC2 + SAML requirements (security team signoff).
- Reliability under spikes is a differentiator vs Zendesk + Ada for them.
- Procurement and legal (2 weeks) then exec signoff. Estimated procurement window Q1.

Open questions / blockers:
- Legal needs written data residency commitments for EU customers (ask Redwood private deployment patterns).
- SAML: timeframe for integration with their IdP (Okta) unknown — impacts rollout date.
- Budget: expected BOM needs to be < $250k ARR first year to get VP Ops buy-in.

Next steps (short):
- 11/04: schedule infra sizing call (owner: Omar).
- 11/06: send POC runbook + security checklist (owner: Maya).
- 11/20: target POC kickoff (depends on legal).
